question: 3rd Largest Company end of August?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve to the third-largest company in the world by market cap on August 31, 2026, as of market close.

The resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

"Other" means any option not listed here.
research:
I couldn't find the official Polymarket prices as of August 11. On the latest pre-cutoff snapshot (August 11), the race for third looks like Apple versus Alphabet. Alphabet sat third, about $147B (3.4%) behind Apple. Nvidia was clear in first, and Microsoft was in fourth, about $600B behind Alphabet.

I left out several pages I found because their figures or market status come from after August 11. These include a Stocktitan "close of August" ranking, the live companiesmarketcap.com table, some October data, and resolved-market pages.

## 1. Resolution source
- The criteria give no URL, only "a consensus of credible reporting." A Manifold copy of this question uses companiesmarketcap.com. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/Bayesian/3rd-largest-company-end-of-august-2)
- 2026-08-11: Money.it's ranking, updated that day: Nvidia $5.269T, Apple $4.498T, Alphabet $4.351T, Microsoft $3.757T, Amazon $2.999T, TSMC $2.170T, Broadcom $2.009T, SpaceX $1.827T, Saudi Aramco $1.713T, Meta $1.515T. [Money.it](https://en.money.it/The-10-most-valuable-companies-in-the-world-August-2026)
- 2026-08-10/11: StatMuse puts Apple at about $4.55T (close $308.26) on Aug 10 and about $4.50T (close $304.91) on Aug 11. [StatMuse](https://www.statmuse.com/money/ask/apple-market-cap-august-2026)
- 2026-08-08 to 08-13: A members-only Quotient page has a smaller Alphabet figure, about $4.18T against Apple's $4.41T, so a gap near $230B. [Quotient](https://signal.quotient.social/signals/464703ab-1411-4882-8af7-5e2bdc63bd63)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing is settled yet. Alphabet is third, 3% to 5% behind Apple depending on the source, so it could swap with Apple over 14 trading days.
- Nvidia (about $5.27T) leads Apple by roughly 17%, so it is unlikely to drop to third.
- Microsoft would need to gain about 16% relative to Alphabet to reach third.
- Tesla, Saudi Aramco and Amazon are all far behind.

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-08-05: Alphabet fell about 4% to about $361 after an AI leadership shake-up, including Jeff Dean leaving after 27 years. It was still up 16% for the year, with a 52-week high of $408.61. [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/alphabet-still-16-2026-googl-183005987.html)
- 2026-07-31: Apple fell about 7.4% to $308.91 after its fiscal Q3 report. Revenue was a record $109.4B, but guidance was weak (supply constraints, memory costs) and services missed. Apple had briefly crossed $5T before the report. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/30/apple-earnings-live-updates.html), [MacRumors](https://www.macrumors.com/2026/07/30/apple-3q-2026-earnings/), [Yahoo](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/why-apple-10-drop-fails-203810284.html)
- 2026-07-26: The Motley Fool wrote that Apple was just over $200B short of $5T, while Alphabet was about $1T away "following its sell-off" (so roughly $4T). [Fool](https://www.fool.com/investing/2026/07/26/prediction-alphabet-will-beat-apple-to-a-5-trillio/)
- 2026-07-22: Alphabet's Q2 revenue rose 24% to $119.8B and Cloud grew 82%. EPS of $9.11 was inflated by a $98B equity gain. MarketBeat snapshots suggest a drop of about 10% after hours, which I could not confirm. [SEC 8-K](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001652044/000165204426000066/googexhibit991q22026.htm), [MarketBeat](https://www.marketbeat.com/earnings/reports/2026-7-22-alphabet-inc-stock-1/)
- 2026-06: Alphabet raised about $80B in equity, including $10B from Berkshire Hathaway. The extra shares raise its market cap. [SEC FWP](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001652044/000119312526251733/d160205dfwp.htm)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026-01-07: Alphabet ($3.88T) passed Apple ($3.84T) for the first time since 2019, so the two have been trading places this year. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/01/07/alphabets-market-cap-surpasses-apples-for-first-time-since-2019.html)
- The ranking has moved a lot within single months. Apple went from about $5T before earnings to about $4.5T, a 10% swing in about a week. Alphabet was down 14% from its May high around mid-July, then recovered toward $4.35T.
- So a 3% to 5% gap between two megacaps over about 3 weeks is well within normal moves. I found no formal statistics on how often third place changes in a month.
- Microsoft has been fourth all summer, about $0.6T behind.

## 5. Other forecasts
- Mid-July 2026: A mirror of the Polymarket market showed Alphabet at about 79-80% for third, Apple about 20%, and Nvidia about 9%. Another listing had Alphabet 83%, Nvidia 12%, Microsoft about 0%. [polymarkets.co.il](https://polymarkets.co.il/en/market/3rd-largest-company-end-of-august-20260715203029875/), [Polyguana](https://polyguana.com/market/2941257)
- A snapshot of the Manifold copy showed Alphabet roughly 37-63% and Apple roughly 7-28%. I could not get its August 11 prices. [Manifold](https://manifold.markets/event/3rd-largest-company-end-of-august-2)
- I found no Kalshi market and no expert forecasts for this date.

## 6. Upcoming events before August 31
- Nvidia's Q2 earnings, usually in the last week of August (date not confirmed). This could swing Nvidia's value and AI stocks generally, including Alphabet.
- The Fed's Jackson Hole symposium in late August (exact date not confirmed), which can move megacap tech as a group.
- Continuing news on Alphabet's AI leadership departures, and on Apple's supply constraints and memory costs.
- Apple's iPhone event is usually in early September, after resolution, but buildup and leaks may move the stock in late August.
- Resolution uses the August 31 close. Sources measure Alphabet's share classes differently (Money.it $4.35T vs Quotient $4.18T), which matters if the race is close.
